preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 2 * 10**5 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S in the test cases has a length between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S in the test cases contains only lowercase English letters.
The sum of the lengths of all strings S in the test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The number of results matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= len(S) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and the length of the corresponding string S inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(1 for k in range(len(S)) if S[k:] + S[:k] == S[k:][::-1] + S[:k][::-1]) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is the number of palindromic cyclic shifts of the corresponding string S.
